instrumentNotes: boundingBox() never used as evidence; every verdict rests on Range.getClientRects() after range.selectNodeContents(el) plus per-character Range rects.

Inner panels were scrolled by walking ancestors with computed overflowY in (auto,scroll) and scrollHeight>clientHeight, then reading scrollTop before/after; on this build the real scroller is document.scrollingElement (html), deltas up to 1353px recorded.

First all-screen sweep pass hit-tested glyphs BEFORE scrolling, which produced a fake 0/N 'not painted'; corrected in _cmdr_wrapcheck_glyph.cjs, which scrolls first. After the fix paintedCount == glyphTotal at every decisive cell.

None of the three words sits in a designed horizontal scroller. The only non-visible overflow above claim 1 is details.v9-evidence-drawer { overflow: hidden } (styles.css:359) with scrollWidth 284 <= clientWidth 286, i.e. a clip, not a scroller. Claims 2 and 3 have overflowAncestors = [].

The earlier refutation shape was checked and is real but does not cover these: button.plan-ranking-sort (硬可用证据段数) IS inside div.plan-ranking-scroll { overflow-x: auto } (features/planning/planRanking.css:19) and was excluded on that basis.
